purpose: Constrain a finite-residence film / Si-C / Si-F-front closure without using any feature depth.
model_form_requirements: separate fluorocarbon-film, Si-C transport-layer, and Si-F reaction-front inventories
C-F bond destruction and Si-F bond formation are paired internal transfers
mixed-layer capacities derive from physical number density and depth rather than one-monolayer caps
ions cross each layer by finite CSDA residual-energy transport with incidence-angle path length
all fitted coefficients are surface-event probabilities or cross sections and carry calibration provenance
no feature depth or reactor flux normalization may be selected by this campaign
evidence_limit: The source is classical MD shown in a primary-author seminar. Passing this protocol validates a reduced representation of that MD response, not quantum-accurate chemistry or oxide transfer.
